messages:
sarah: :rotating_light: cred-scan just flagged an API key leak in logs for team-infra -> partner-integration. Key looks like third_party:prod:key_ABC123. Need immediate containment and rotation. Who can own?

matt: I can take lead on rotation. Confirmed found in logs at s3://prod-logs/team-infra/2026/03/21/partner.log lines ~345-360.

anya: tagging incident. I'm creating INCIDENT-2026-03-21 in PagerDuty and an internal task. Will we need a short deploy freeze? :lock:

kevin: we should assume the key is compromised. Steps: 1) revoke the key with partner 2) rotate locally (Vault/KMS) 3) scan codebase + history for commits 4) update configs and redeploy canaries.

matt: plan: revoke partner key now (pinging partner ops), then rotate the internal credential stored in Vault (kv v2) and rewrap via our KMS. I'll run the commands.

deploy-bot: (automated) cred-scan alert: findings=1 severity=high file=/mnt/logs/partner.log pattern=key_ABC123

anya: @matt please add short checklist to INCIDENT-2026-03-21. I'll notify legal/security comms after containment.

matt: doing rotation steps now. Commands I'm running:
```bash
# remove leaked key from partner (they asked to revoke)
# partner API: DELETE /keys/ABC123
curl -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer <partner-admin-token>" https://partner.example.com/api/keys/ABC123

# rotate in Vault (kv v2)
vault kv put secret/team-infra/partner api_key=@new_key_value owner=matt rotated_at=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)

# rewrap with KMS (gcp kms example)
echo -n "$NEW_KEY" | gcloud kms encrypt --location=global --keyring=redwood-prod --key=partners-key --ciphertext-file=- | base64 > partner_key.enc
```

kevin: also run a repo search for the key pattern and any variants. Quick grep examples: 
```bash
grep -R "ABC123" --line-number || true
git log --all --grep="ABC123" --oneline || true
```

sarah: I ran a quick grep across prod buckets, found one config that loads the leaked key into a legacy env var in infra-service v1. Patch and remove immediately.

matt: removed legacy env var from infra-service v1, pushed a hotfix. Triggering a canary deploy to staging then prod (no downtime expected).

ops-oncall: before we deploy prod, ensure audit logs are on for Vault and KMS for the rotation event. Set retention and mark this rotation event id in logs.

anya: noted — I'll ensure audit-export flag is set and capture the rotation event IDs in the incident ticket. We should also snapshot Vault metadata for post-incident forensics.

kevin: question on RBAC: do we need to temporarily tighten Vault read to team-infra only while we rotate? Could lock down read until we confirm no further exposure.

matt: I'll create a short-lived policy that denies other teams read to secret/team-infra/* and attach to a temporary role. Command:
```bash
vault policy write lockdown - <<'HCL'
path "secret/data/team-infra/*" {
  capabilities = ["read"]
}
HCL
# then bind to team-infra only
vault write auth/kubernetes/role/team-infra ...
```

kevin: I meant deny — we want only team-infra. We'll coordinate with SRE for minimal blast radius.

anya: partner confirmed revocation request accepted. They returned a ticket ID PART-2026-431. They asked us to rotate our upstream tokens and provide new key via their secure portal.

matt: done. New key generated, stored in Vault, rewrapped in KMS, and uploaded to partner portal. Pushed hotfix to prod. Canaries healthy.

ops-oncall: please post rotation audit snippets here once available (vault revoke metadata, cms rewrap ids). Need for compliance evidence.

matt: attaching audit snippets below (redacted):
```
# Vault audit entry (redacted)
{"time":"2026-03-21T14:12:03Z","type":"write","path":"secret/data/team-infra/partner","request_id":"req-abc-123"}
# KMS rewrap id: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/redwood/cryptoKeys/partners-key/cryptoKeyVersions/3
```

sarah: I'm running a full creds blast-radius scan now (search logs, buckets, CI artifacts). If we find artifacts, we'll rotate those service tokens too.

kevin: check GH actions artifacts: grep in actions logs and runner caches. Also run the database query to find any stored tokens. Example SQL: 
```sql
SELECT id, service, created_at FROM secrets WHERE value LIKE '%ABC123%' LIMIT 100;
```

anya: legal wants timeline: time of detection, revocation, rotation complete, and list of affected systems. I'll compile from ticket.

matt: rotation complete at 2026-03-21T14:18:45Z. Canaries healthy. No further matches in prod logs after hotfix (ran post-rotation scans).

deploy-bot: (automated) post-rotation scan: matches=0 severity=high path_scanned=s3://prod-logs/team-infra/2026/03/21

ops-oncall: recommend — add a temporary rule in ingress that denies outgoing calls to partner endpoints from older infra-service versions until they pick up new key. Helps prevent re-exfil.

kevin: good call. I'll add a network-level denylist for versions < 1.2.4 and reference incident id.

anya: action items summary (adding owners):
- Matt: rotate key in Vault + KMS and upload to partner (done)
- Kevin: RBAC lockdown to team-infra and network denylist (in-progress)
- Sarah: blast-radius scans and artifact cleanup (in-progress)
- Anya: incident ticket and legal/comms (done)
- Ops-oncall: collect audit logs and retention proof (in-progress)

sarah: one more: we should schedule a follow-up to rotate any long-lived tokens and consider ephemeral tokens for future partner integrations. I'll schedule a 30-min postmortem tomorrow. :calendar:

matt: agreed — propose moving partner keys to short-lived JWT flow. I'll draft an RFC for Redwood Integrations.

anya: thanks everyone. Marking INCIDENT-2026-03-21 as in containment. Will update once RBAC lockdown and final scans complete. :white_check_mark:
